# Mohit Koli — mohitkoli.in

> Full-stack developer based in India. Publishes price-checked guides on web
> hosting, domains, SEO and eCommerce, with pricing verified against vendor
> storefronts on the Indian market and dated on each page.

All prices quoted are in INR for the Indian storefront and carry the month they
were checked. Intro rates and renewal rates are always stated separately,
because they differ substantially in this category.

## Tools

- [Hosting Cost Calculator](https://mohitkoli.in/tools/hosting-cost-calculator): Total cost of hosting over 1-10 years in India, comparing discounted long-term pricing against standard renewal rates, including GST.

## Hosting

- [Hostinger Plans & Pricing India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/hostinger-plans-pricing-india-2026): Every tier with intro and renewal rates, specs, KVM VPS and Agency plans.
- [Hostinger Renewal Price India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/hostinger-renewal-price-india-2026): What each plan costs after the intro term ends, with the multi-year arithmetic.
- [Hostinger Business Plan (now Unlimited)](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/hostinger-business-plan): The plan renamed from Business to Unlimited in 2026 — specs, price and who it suits.
- [Cheap Web Hosting Under ₹200 India](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/cheap-web-hosting-under-200-india): Budget plans that are worth it and the ones that are cheap for a reason.
- [Best Web Hosting India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/best-web-hosting-india-2026): Provider comparison for the Indian market.
- [Best VPS Hosting India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/best-vps-hosting-india-2026): KVM VPS specs, prices and renewal rates.
- [Cloud Hosting India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/hostinger-cloud-hosting-india-2026): When dedicated resources are worth the jump from shared.
- [WordPress Hosting India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/hostinger-wordpress-hosting-india-2026): Managed WordPress hosting, what actually matters.
- [Node.js Hosting India 2026](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/nodejs-hosting-india-2026): Running Node apps on Indian hosting.
- [Migrate WordPress to a New Host](https://mohitkoli.in/blog/migrate-wordpress-to-new-host): Zero-downtime migration, including the DNS TTL step.
